Before I can give my final approval, our standard checklist requires formal recorded readouts from both the Intellectual Property Counsel and the Privacy and Clinical Regulatory Counsel. Could each of you please provide your formal recorded readout so we can proceed?

transcript.text: Thank you both for flagging these critical issues. Both of you have identified material gaps between the current draft and requirements that must be addressed before I can approve this agreement. Nadia, the current draft's publication provisions conflict with our non-negotiable clinical-data position — we need to prohibit publication of patient-level data and require de-identification before any permitted external publication. Elias, the exclusive commercial license to all background technology cannot stand as drafted — background patents U1, U2, and U3 must be excluded from any commercial license, and separate written university consent must be required before any commercial use of those patents. I'd like each of you to complete your formal recorded readouts for the record, incorporating these findings, so we have a clear basis for the required draft revisions.
